quarterly_data.quarter: Longsys investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its self-developed SPU (storage processing unit) chip, combined with its proprietary iSA (storage agent), efficiently identifies and offloads warm/cold data to lower the DRAM capacity end devices need, which it says gives advantages in cost optimization and local deployment of AI large models; the technology and products are still being commercialized and their contribution to results will take time.
